title: SMS Marketing: An Intro to Marketing with Text Messages [2022]

facts.fact: The page says SMS marketing software typically costs anywhere from $0.009 to $0.10 per message, per the vendor's own estimate.
facts.quote: expect to spend anywhere from $.009 to $.10 per message.

facts.fact: The page says that SMS marketing's per-message cost can rise if the business pays an agency to manage SMS, if the platform adds carrier or platform fees, or if it sends MMS instead of SMS.
facts.quote: That price may increase based on a few things:

facts.fact: The page says marketers spend between $10 and $1,000 per month on email marketing, citing a WebFX source (a third-party claim, not the vendor's own data).
facts.quote: marketers spend [between $10-$1,000 on email marketing per month.

facts.fact: The vendor states that SMS has nearly 100% open rates (the vendor's own claim, not sourced to data on the page).
facts.quote: With nearly 100% open rates and clickthrough rates that blast email and paid advertising out of the water

facts.fact: The page cites a third-party source (TextAnywhere) saying a good SMS click-through rate is around 10% or more.
facts.quote: clickthrough rates that blast email and paid advertising out of the water ([think 10% and more]

facts.fact: The page says SMS marketing has existed technically since the 1990s but rose to widespread popularity in the 2010s decade.
facts.quote: SMS marketing has technically been around since the 1990s, but this is the decade that it has risen to widespread popularity.
